verdictA.scope: The selected target is pinned to the intended published 0.2.205 item and digest, and the workflow token is checked against both the pin and approved baseline before setup.
evidence: .github/workflows/hosted-guest-acceptance.yml passes 0.2.205 at preflight and acceptance and describes that public CRX version.

scripts/published-store-crx-target.mjs pins version, item ID, and SHA-256; scripts/hosted-guest-acceptance.mjs checks downloaded bytes, CRX3 signing key/ID, manifest version, and adapted tree receipt.
Focused tests prove stale workflow token, baseline version, and baseline item are refused; hosted preflight refuses 0.2.130 before browser setup.
liveLimits: No hosted/native/Store-installed acceptance was performed in this review. Workflow run 37267277216 was pending at inspection.
This verifies the code's pinned target and validation chain; it does not prove current availability from Google's update service or Store-installed lifecycle/profile behavior.

evidence: The 0.2.130 literal was replaced with one shared target module, removing version duplication from the download and receipt path.
Provenance checks remain in the download path: byte digest, CRX3 format/signing key matched to item ID, payload manifest version, store metadata handling, and adapted-tree hash/receipt.
The focused unit suite passed 4/4 with TMPDIR=/Volumes/Samsung2TB/code/.stabilization-scratch. An initial run using the system temp volume failed two mkdtemp calls with ENOSPC; no assertions failed.
CI invokes the focused test. The target guard tests stale workflow version and baseline version/item drift.
limitations: The guard tests do not independently mutate the pinned digest or signing-key constant; the download path's digest/signing checks remain the runtime enforcement for those values.
The implementer's recorded RED/mutation evidence was not rerun in this review lane.
